@graph.name: Pricing - ZenML
@graph.description: One plan, $39 a month: your AI engineer on one AI agent, one ML project and your whole team. Open source is free; more agents, projects and on-prem are a conversation.

acceptedAnswer.text: One AI agent with your AI engineer on it, one ML project with up to 100 pipeline runs a month, and as many seats as you want. It starts with a 14-day trial, no credit card.
An AI agent is anything you want your AI engineer to watch: its code, in one repo or several, and the traces it sends. A LangGraph app with three sub-agents that ships as one product is one agent.

mainEntity.name: Is there a limit on sessions?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Your AI engineer reads every session your agent sends. Replays run with your own model keys, so those model costs stay on your bill.

mainEntity.name: What if we need more agents, projects or runs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Talk to us. Enterprise covers more agents, more ML projects and more pipeline runs, priced on what you actually run, along with on-prem and governance if you need them.
Because everyone who knows what good looks like should be in it: engineers, product, and the domain experts who review sessions. A team of fifteen pays the same as a team of two.
The trial is full access and needs no credit card. When it ends, add a card to keep going. Nothing in your workspace changes except the billing. Open source stays free, forever.

On Starter, your AI engineer runs in our cloud and reads traces from your tracing tool through keys you can revoke. ZenML stores only metadata; your data, artifacts and compute stay in your cloud. Self-hosted or on Enterprise on-prem, nothing leaves your infrastructure.
Yes, on Enterprise. Your AI engineer and ZenML run inside your own cloud or on-prem, air-gapped if you need it, with your own LLM endpoint.

mainEntity.name: How is this different from Langfuse, Braintrust or LangSmith?

acceptedAnswer.text: They show you what happened. Our AI engineer reads those traces next to your evals and shows you which evals are wrong or missing, then Kitaru replays your agent to test the fix against real sessions. Kitaru imports from Langfuse, LangSmith, Braintrust, Logfire, MLflow or Phoenix, so your tracing tool stays your system of record.

mainEntity.name: Is there a startup or academic discount?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Early-stage companies, universities and research institutions can apply for special pricing. Apply here (/startups-and-academics).
